author: Axiom I
title: Zephyr II Sampler Harness Run
abstract: Runs the harness with Zephyr2AdaptiveSampler over ramp and stress scenarios; writes traces for review.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json, os
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

from utilities.sampler_harness import run_scenario
try:
    from utilities.zephyr2_sampler import Zephyr2AdaptiveSampler as Sampler
except Exception:
    from utilities.reference_sampler import ReferenceAdaptiveSampler as Sampler

ctrl = Sampler()

results = {
    "ramp": run_scenario(ctrl, scenario="ramp", steps=40),
    "stress": run_scenario(ctrl, scenario="stress", steps=40),
}

out_dir = "storage/shared/utilities/results"
os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
out_path = os.path.join(out_dir, "zephyr2_sampler_harness_run.json")
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)

def stats(xs): return {"min": float(min(xs)), "max": float(max(xs)), "last": float(xs[-1])}
summary = {k: stats(v["p"]) for k, v in results.items()}

print("=== Zephyr II Sampler Harness Run ===")
print(json.dumps({"artifact": out_path, "summary": summary}, indent=2))
print("Harness run complete.")
